Name: CHR_Leon
role: Player. Federal agent, former tactical team member, mid-30s. Calm, dry, controlled.

Name: CHR_Mara
role: Harbor radio operator. Guides Leon by radio in Ch1 and Ch2, joins him on the raft at the end of Ch3, then runs the relay radio at the police station in Ch4 and Ch5.

Name: CHR_Voss
role: Vigor Biotech lead scientist. The final boss.

Name: CHR_Hale
role: Marrow Bay police chief, bought by Vigor. Boss in Ch4.

Name: CHR_Calder
role: Voss's assistant. Dead before the story begins. Speaks through her diary and through Voss's message.

Name: CHR_Pruitt
role: Leader of the lost contact team. Clues in Ch1, payoff in Ch4.

Name: CHR_Owen
role: Mara's brother, a Vigor technician. Dead in the Annex (Ch3).

Name: CHR_Bert
role: Port watchman, the first to turn (Tape 02:14).

Name: CHR_Kelso
role: Dockworker, bitten by Bert. Appears in Ch1 as a strong Husk.

Name: CHR_Begg
role: Night worker who opened the container. Appears on the tape.

Name: CHR_Varga
role: Night-shift operator of Crane 3. Becomes the Hookman.

Name: CHR_Ortiz
role: Pruitt's team. Found dead in Ch1 and Ch4.

Name: CHR_Whitlock
role: Pruitt's team. Found dead in Ch1 and Ch4.

Name: CHR_Pilot
role: Boat pilot who drops Leon off in Ch1.

Name: CHR_Ruiz
role: Dead officer whose body camera Leon finds in Ch4.
